newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Deustche may take Mundial stake - paper.
newsitem.headline: Deustche may take Mundial stake - paper.

text.p: Germany's Deutsche Bank AG might take a stake in Portuguese insurer Mundial Confianca as part of a restructuring of Portuguese businessman Antonio Champalimaud's financial interests, Publico reported at the weekend.

Quoting a source close to Champalimaud, the newspaper said the group was studying how Deutsche Bank, which has already signed a cooperation agreement with Champalimaud, might buy a 20 percent stake in the insurer from Banco Comercial Portugues (BCP).
"The partnership with Deustche Bank could be strengthened by the German institution taking a stake," the source was quoted as saying.

Publico quoted another official in the Champalimaud group, which includes Banco Totta & Acores (BTA) and Banco Pinto & Sotto Mayor (BPSM), as saying that such an acquisition would make sense because Champalimaud's was the only Portuguese banking group without a foreign strategic partner.
The group is in the process of an internal restructuring that will bring its banks under a common board of directors and streamline administration, accounting and information technology.
